title: The Apostolic Council in Jerusalem
description: The apostles and the elders meet in Jerusalem to clarify whether Gentile Christians must be circumcised and keep the Mosaic Law. Peter and James speak, and they decide that salvation comes through Jesus' grace, but they ask Gentile Christians to abstain from food offered to idols, blood, meat from strangled animals, and sexual immorality. The letter is sent with Judas and Silas to Antioch.
